content:
## Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: Simple Style Guide for Elements


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034719

In this article, the styling Classes of the Pricing Page menu will be outlined:

The Pricing Page modules consists of:

1. Title

2. Price

3. Sub-Price

4. Features

5. Checkout Button


## How Are These Applied in the Admin Dashboard?



### Title


For Title use the class " title ":


### Price


For the Price use the class " price ":


### Sub Price


For the Sub Pricing use the class " sub- price ":


### Button


To create a button, we recommend using the class " btn btn-success btn-lg vmargin bold ".
